top_deficiency_types.title: Safeguard resident-identifiable information and/or maintain medical records on each resident that are in accordance with accepted professional standards.
top_deficiency_types.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Protect each resident from all types of abuse such as physical, mental, sexual abuse, physical punishment, and neglect by anybody.
top_deficiency_types.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Provide the appropriate treatment and services to a resident who displays or is diagnosed with dementia.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Ensure heating and ventilation systems that have been properly installed according to the manufacturer's instructions.
Add doors in an exit area that do not require the use of a key from the exit side unless in case of special locking arrangements.
Have horizontal exits used in accordance with safety requirements.
Ensure that special areas are constructed so that walls can resist fire for one hour or have an approved fire extinguishing system.
Have approved installation, maintenance and testing program for fire alarm systems.
